title: Awesome and soft, but poorly made
text: Awesome and soft, but poorly made. I love this comforter. The problem is it’s not made too well. The stitching started to unravel the first wash. Even without putting it in the dryer. It’s soft and big. It just needs to be sewn a little bit better.
